    Package Description
    org.tmt.aps.peas.common.cdi
    CDI (Component Dependency Injection) related classes that define annotations specific to PEAS-PCS.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.business
    Computation library EJB and computation exception classes.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.business
    Procedure execution management, procedure execution state, procedure store and retrieval, procedure output store and retrieval.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.executor
    Executors for procedures and subflows implemented as Singleton EJBs.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.visualization.business
    State caches and utility functions to enable asynchronous displays of user prompts and visualization displays.
